overview.title: Privacy and GDPR
overview.subtitle: Records of processing, impact assessments, data subject requests, breaches, processors and transfers in one place.
overview.noBreaches: No open breaches. Register one the moment you become aware of it.

ropa.name: Processing record
ropa.description: Your Article 30 record: what personal data you process, why, on which legal basis and for how long.

dpia.name: DPIA
dpia.description: Screen high-risk processing and assess the risks to people before you start.

dsr.name: Data subject request
dsr.description: Requests to access, correct, erase or move personal data, answered within one month.

breach.name: Personal data breach
breach.description: Personal data breaches with the 72-hour clock and the notification decisions.

processor.name: Processor
processor.description: Who processes personal data on your behalf, and whether a data processing agreement is in place.

transfer.name: International transfer
transfer.description: Transfers of personal data outside the EEA, the transfer tool used and the transfer impact assessment.

retention.name: Retention schedule
retention.description: How long each kind of personal data is kept, and what happens to it afterwards.

consent.name: Consent record
consent.description: Evidence of the consents you rely on: who agreed to what, when, how, and any withdrawal.

lba.name: Legal basis assessment
lba.description: Why a processing is lawful, including the three-part test for legitimate interests.

fields.title: Title
fields.subjects_notification_required: Must the people affected be told?
fields.disposal_method: At the end of the period

breachRisk.unlikely: Unlikely to result in a risk

evaluation_scoring.label: Evaluation or scoring
evaluation_scoring.hint: Profiling or predicting, e.g. credit scoring or performance.

automated_decisions.label: Automated decisions with legal or similar effect
automated_decisions.hint: Decisions made without a person that affect someone significantly.

systematic_monitoring.label: Systematic monitoring
systematic_monitoring.hint: Observing or tracking people, e.g. CCTV or location tracking.

sensitive_data.label: Sensitive or highly personal data
sensitive_data.hint: Health, criminal records, financial data and other special categories.

large_scale.label: Large scale
large_scale.hint: Many people, much data, a long time or a wide area.

matching_datasets.label: Matching or combining datasets
matching_datasets.hint: Joining data from sources in ways people would not expect.

vulnerable_subjects.label: Vulnerable people
vulnerable_subjects.hint: Children, employees, patients or others with less power.

innovative_technology.label: Innovative technology
innovative_technology.hint: New technology or new uses, e.g. biometrics or AI.

prevents_rights.label: Prevents people from using a right or service
prevents_rights.hint: The processing decides access to a service or contract.

form.changeReasonHint: Kept in the revision history so auditors can see why the record changed.
form.personalNotice: This register holds personal data. Record only what you need to handle the matter, and only people with access to requests can see it.

common.loadFailed: Could not load the data. Try again.

dsr.deadlineExplain: Received {{ received }}. The answer is due within one month, by {{ due }}, unless the deadline is extended.
dsr.extendHint: Only once, before the first deadline, when the request is complex or there are many requests. Tell the requester why within the first month.
dsr.extendMessage: The deadline moves two months later. Explain why; the requester must be told within the first month.
dsr.outcomeMessage: Describe what you did, or why the request was refused. A refusal must tell the person about their right to complain to the authority.

breach.clockExplain: You became aware on {{ aware }}. The authority must be notified within 72 hours of that moment, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to people.
breach.authorityNotRequired: Decided that no notification is needed.
breach.subjectsNotRequired: Decided that they are not told.
breach.subjectsPending: Must be told, not done yet.

decisionHint.authority: Decide whether the authority must be notified. If not, write down why: the reasoning must be documented even when you do not notify.
decisionHint.subjects: When the risk to people is high they must be told without undue delay, unless an Art. 34(3) exemption applies.

dpia.priorConsultationExplain: The residual risk is still high. Under Art. 36 you must consult the supervisory authority before you start the processing.
dpia.riskDescription: Describe the risk to the people affected

lba.liaExplain: Legitimate interests need a documented three-part test: a legitimate purpose, a necessary processing, and a balance that does not override the people's interests and rights.

consent.withdrawHint: When the person withdraws their consent, record it here. Stop the processing that relied on it.
consent.withdrawMessage: The consent is marked as withdrawn now. This cannot be undone; a new consent needs a new record.

decision.title: Decision

notYet.dpia: When the assessment is complete, set the status to "Awaiting decision" so an approver can decide.
notYet.lba: When the assessment is complete, set the status to "Awaiting decision" so an approver can decide.

decision.dialogMessage: Your decision is recorded with your name and the time.

statusHint.ropa: An active record must have the Article 30 information filled in.
statusHint.dpia: Move to "Awaiting decision" when the assessment is complete. A DPIA cannot be marked not required while the screening says it is required.
statusHint.dsr: Completing or refusing a request needs an outcome.
statusHint.breach: A breach is closed only when both notification decisions are on record.
statusHint.processor: A processor can only be active with a signed agreement, or one documented as not required.
statusHint.transfer: A transfer that relies on SCCs, BCRs or another tool can only be active after a positive transfer impact assessment.
statusHint.retention: Activate the rule once it has been agreed.
statusHint.consent: Consent is active until it is withdrawn.
statusHint.lba: Move to "Awaiting decision" when the assessment is complete.

detail.deleteMessage: The record is removed from the register. It stays in the audit trail.

ai.ropaHint: Describe the processing in your own words. The assistant fills in the form for you to check; nothing is saved until you save.
ai.ropaPlaceholder: For example: we keep customer names, emails and order history in our web shop to deliver orders and handle returns…
ai.applied: The suggestion was added to the form. Review every field before saving.
ai.breachHint: Get a draft risk assessment and a notification recommendation based on this record.
ai.disclaimer: A draft to support you. The decision is yours.

ask.field: Explain "{{ field }}" in plain language, in the context of the GDPR.
ask.summarise: Summarise {{ code }} and tell me what is missing or due.

notices.extended: The deadline of {{ code }} was extended.
notices.withdrawn: The withdrawal of {{ code }} was recorded.

errors.notFound: The record was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.module_disabled: The privacy module is turned off for this organisation.
errors.invalid_owner: The owner must be a member of the organisation.
errors.invalid_reference: A linked record does not exist: {{ fields }}.
errors.invalid_fields: These fields cannot be changed here: {{ fields }}.
errors.invalid_sort: That sort order is not supported.
errors.invalid_status: This can only be decided while it is awaiting a decision.
errors.ropa_incomplete: Before the record can be active, fill in: {{ fields }}.
errors.dpia_required: The screening shows a DPIA is required, so it cannot be marked as not required.
errors.outcome_required: Record the outcome, or the reason for the refusal, first.
errors.already_extended: The deadline has already been extended once.
errors.extension_too_late: The deadline can only be extended before the first deadline has passed.
errors.delay_reason_required: The authority was notified after 72 hours: give the reason for the delay.
errors.subjects_exemption_required: For a high-risk breach, not telling the people affected needs an Art. 34(3) exemption.
errors.authority_not_required: The decision says the authority need not be notified. Change the decision first.
errors.breach_decisions_pending: Record both notification decisions before closing: {{ fields }}.
errors.dpa_required: A processor can only be active with a signed agreement, or one documented as not required.
errors.dpa_signed_at_required: Enter the date the agreement was signed.
errors.transfer_incomplete: Before the transfer can be active, fill in: {{ fields }}.
errors.tia_incomplete: Complete the transfer impact assessment first.
errors.transfer_not_adequate: The assessment found the protection inadequate, so the transfer cannot be active.
errors.tia_conclusion_required: Enter the conclusion of the transfer impact assessment.
errors.lia_incomplete: Complete the legitimate interests test first: {{ fields }}.
